search_method.sources: Web search for named works and capability terms; primary arXiv/publisher/official project pages then section/source inspection. PyPI JSON queried directly for release metadata.
search_method.inclusion: Foundational transit/inference methods; requested fitting systems; calibration and model checking; reproducibility/provenance; contemporary closely related astronomy studies.
search_method.exclusion: Unverified mirrors, marketing claims, search snippets without identifiable primary work, unrelated retrieval/detection studies when not needed for methodological overlap.
